manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 201
text:
Page 001
001-1. IT'S A PITY THAT I CAN'T WIN AGAINST HER..
001-2. WERE YOU ALREADY AWAKE?
001-3. NOPE, I JUST WOKE UP.

Page 002
002-1. I DON'T BELIEVE You.
002-2. I SUSPECT THAT SHE'S TRYING TO ENTRAP ME AGAIN...
002-3. WHETHER YOU BELIEVE IT OR NOT, IT'S UP TO YOU.
002-4. YOU CAN JUST CHANGE HERE YOU KNOW, I WON'T PEEK.
002-5. WHATARE YOU DoING THEN?
002-6. I'M CLOSING MY EYES NOW!

Page 003
003-1. WHY AREN'T YOU CHANGING YET?
003-2. IF WE DON'T TRUST EACH OTHER IN TIMES LIKE THESE, THIS RELATIONSHIP WILL BE HARD TO LAST--
003-3. I'LL HIT YOU IF YOU DARE TO PEEK!

Page 004
004-1. SHE WOULD USUALLY HEAD TO THE STORAGE ROOMJUSTTOCHANGE HER CLOTHES. ID SAY THAT THIS IS A BIG IMPROVEMENT,
004-2. SINCE WE HAVEN'T BEEN SLEEPING TOGETHER THANKS TO MYCOLD, I GUESS ABSENCEREALLYMAKES THE HEART GROW FONDER.
004-3. ARE WHAT WE ARE NOW CONSIDERED ABNORMAL?
004-4. IN WHICH ASPECT ARE YOU REFER- RING TO? THOUGHITHINKWEWERENEVER NORMAL TOBEGINWITH 扭捏

Page 005
005-1. .US SLEEPING TOGETHER.
005-2. IT'S NORMAL TO SLEEP TOGETHER, WHAT'S ABNORMAL'IS THATYOU'RE STILL WARY OF ME AFTER ALREADY SLEEPING TOGETHER.
005-3. HOW WOULD MODERN PEOPLE BE LIKE THEN?
005-4. HMM...MODERN PEOPLE...PROBABLY WOULDN'T HAVE ANY RESERVATIONS ABOUT ANYTHING ANYMORE,
005-5. GURGLE... BE RUNNING AROUND THE HOUSE BUTT NAKED...
005-6. THERE'S NOTHING WRONG WITH STICKING TO THE OLD BELIEFS FROM THE KAIYUAN ERA,AND IT'S HARD TO FIND SOMEONE WHO IS LIKE THAT THESE DAYS.
005-7. I'M JUST TEASING HERFROMTIMETO TIME, BUT IT HAS BACKFIRED.. MAYGODFORGIVEME

Page 006
006-1. NO, IT'S STILL BETTERTO GET HER USED TO IT EARLY!
006-2. I PROMISED PINGPING TO GO FISHING WITH HER,
006-3. IS THERE ANYTHING YOU WANT ME TO GET ON THE WAY?

Page 007
007-1. NOPE, I'LL BE HEADING OUT IN A BIT TOO.
007-2. THAT'S RIGHT, DO YOU WANT TO COME FIND ME AT MY PARENTS'HOUSE AT NOON? I MIGHT BE HAVING MY LUNCH THERE.
007-3. IN THAT CASE, I'LL GO FISHING WITHPINGPINGIN THE AFTERNOON INSTEAD OF IN THE MORNING.
007-4. IT'S OKAY, YOU CAN GO, THEY YOU CAN GO,THEY MIGHTNOT EVEN WANTME AROUND FOR LUNCH.
007-5. OH, I JUST SAW JIANG HE AND HER FRIEND HEADING OUT WITH THEIR FISHING RODS,WHY DIDN'T YOU JOIN THEM?
007-6. IT'S BECALISE I'M TOO GOOD AT FISHING,AND THEY FEEL ASHAMED WHEN I'MAROLND.

Page 008
008-1. KEEP BRAGGING, I SEE THEM WITH BUCKETS FULL OF FISH ALL THE TIME.
008-2. DAD_ WHERE'S MOM?
008-3. SHE WENT TO PLAY MAHJONG.
008-4. THIS EARLY IN THE MORNING, DOESN'T SHE USL- ALLY PLAY IN THE AFTERNOONS?
008-5. THIS POMELO IS GOOD!DIDYOUR WORKPLACE GIVE YOU THIS?
008-6. THERE ARE A FEW MORE IN THEKITCHEN, IF YOU LIKE IT, YOU CAN TAKE A COUPLE HOME FOR JIANG HE AND YOU TO EAT.

Page 009
009-1. THIS RASCAL IS PROBABLY HERE FOR SOMETHING WELL, COIN- CIDENTALLY, I HAVE SOMETHING FOR HIM TOO.
009-2. JUST SAY IT, WHAT DO YOUWANT THIS TIME?
009-3. DON'T WORRY, I'M NOT HERE TO ASK FOR THE HOUSE.
009-4. I WOULDN'T HANDIT TO YOU EVEN IF YOU WANTED IT, GIVE IT UP.
009-5. WHAT, COULD IT BE THAT YOU'RE FINALLY ENLIGHTENED AND ARE HERE TOASKME TO FIND A PROPER JOB FOR YOU?
009-6. CAN'T I JUST PURELY COME HERE TO HANG OUT?
009-7. WHY DON'T WE TALK ABOUT THAT TIME WHEN I BRAVELY SAVED...
009-8. I'M LEAVING.
009-9. I JUST WANTED TO ASK, DID YOU APPROACHAUNTIE CHENG TO ASK ABOUT JIANG HE?

Page 010
010-1. WHO APPROACHED HER?
010-2. ARE YOU SAYING THAT AUNTIE CHENG IS LYING?
010-3. …I WAS JUST PARKING MY CAR PAKKINC 77 CAK OVER THERE AND WE WERE JUST CHIT-CHAT- TING, AND THE CON- VERSATION DRIFTED TOWARDS THAT.
010-4. YEAH YEAH, JUST PASSING BY AND CHIT- CHATTING.
010-5. SO,ARE YOU ABLE TO HELP RESOLVE IT?
010-6. WHAT DOES IT HAVE TO DO WITH ME?
